cues.texto: She did all of this on her own...
Senku!
Over there!
NITRIC ACID FIELD
It took me
so, so many years to get here...
I failed so, so many times...
A saltpeter field made from animal waste...
The method was commonly used in Japan during the Sengoku era.
It takes a ridiculous amount of time...
In spite of that,
it's a ten billion percent certain and steady way to get the Revival Fluid.
You truly are something...
Suika.
But I could only make enough for one person,
so I decided to wake you up first.
Yeah, the order's correct too. You get a full ten billion points.
Well, it's time for a science craft show seven years worth of work.
ORIGINAL WORK: RIICHIRO INAGAKI, BOICHI SHUEISHA "JUMP COMICS"
- Done. - In just a day?
But it took me so many years!
I knew you'd be so amazing, Senku!
OBTAINED NITRIC ACID!
I just made it in a different way.
It's super quick if you have some platinum.
Then we just need alcohol.
We'll need to wait half a month until it ferments.
Meanwhile, we'll have to make more nitric acid every day.
In 16 days, we'll have 16 vials of Revival Fluid.
All done in one go.
Suika?
Looks like we're more or less the same age now, Kohaku...
I guess I can't ask you for hugs anymore...
Ryusui! François!
It's been a long time, Miss Suika.
You really gave it all, Suika.
There are 16 vials of Revival Fluid.
That means there's enough for all of us.
We'll discuss what to do about the enemies tomorrow.
For now, let's just bring all our allies back!
As always, I feel amazing once I come out of petrification!
I wonder if someone as old as me
could still make it to the end of our adventure
if I got petrified now and then.
Besides, it looks like Suika's grown up.
Aren't you all catching up to my age too?
Wait...
Could we have kept Kaseki as a stone for a while to let him live longer?
There's no way the petrification device could bring him back if he dies, right?
Oh, no!
We couldn't possibly fix the ships and all without you, Kaseki.
You really are relying on me! I'll do my best!
- Senku. - Huh?
What about Hyoga?
Yeah, we're using our last vial of Revival Fluid on him.
And then our group of friends will be complete!
I've been waiting years for this after putting you all in line.
There's a chance that Hyoga won't...
- Whoa! - Whoa!
There's always that perfect line to drop at a time like this, Hyoga!
Do you mean "thank you"? You really don't have to.
That's not it. I'm talking about Hyoga's...
Really on point, indeed.
You're all the best!
- Hurrah! - Hurrah!
Starting tomorrow,
we'll be reviving everyone in North America, Japan, Treasure Island...
No, we'll be reviving every human on earth once again!
But tonight, we're having a victory feast!
What's wrong, Suika? You're not eating...
Every day, I always ate my meals alone.
Always... All alone...
That's why I somehow feel full already
just by being with everyone!
Suika...
We're supposed to have a party tonight!
Just being happy with filling your heart's hunger
is way too humble, don't you think?
Here it is.
If you want it, there you go.
It's coconut milk fruit soup.
It's delicious!
It tastes even better because I'm eating with all of you!
This is the tastiest stuff I've ever had in my life!
By the way, Senku, you kept your cracks from the revival.
In the end, the cracks just weathered away as they were.
Senku...
It looks like Tsukasa went to the watermill by himself...
Senku?
I need everyone's attention!
The mentalist is back after seven years!
And I'll give you a victory magic show!
- Yeah! - Hooray!
Damn... I drank too much!
Could we have kept Kaseki as a stone for a while
to let him live longer?
Oh, well...
Out of all of us that got depetrified,
Kaseki will be the first to go.
I had never thought about that before.
Since he had lost consciousness,
Hyoga couldn't have noticed himself,
but he was already dead by then.
I had plenty of time.
I didn't get it wrong.
If it's coming from you, Tsukasa, then it can't be wrong.
I've had this hypothesis ever since my neck was broken,
or since you were in your cold sleep.
And I had been able to prove it
through an unintentional, life-risking experiment.
Petrification rejects even death itself.
Whyman's Dr. Stone...
is a scientific taboo
about resurrecting the dead that humans shouldn't touch.
A forbidden fruit.
In other words, at this very moment, we hold
the key to eternal life...
for every human on Earth.
Awesome!
Are you serious? This is awesome! In that case...
Kaseki will keep on living too!
Yeah, that could be possible. We should thank Whyman.
He was just acting like a villain because he was scary.
Maybe he's actually a really good guy?
But he's trying to turn us all into stone...
I don't get it. What kind of guy is Whyman?
Our only option
is to go ask him before Medusa rains down on Earth again.
Yeah.
All the way to the Moon.
We're actually planning a fun trip to the Moon?
Whoa! How convenient that you have a hardcore expert here!
Freshly made Revival Fluid, vial number 17.
Is it really alright to revive Xeno already?
It's fine.
That's right...
As long as you're here, Tsukasa, he can't go on a rampage or anything.
As long as we can keep Stanley under control.
It might not even be a problem of brute force anymore.
That thing has changed the rules of this world, ten billion percent.
The light of immortality!
It's an elegant yet wicked science that defies the laws of nature.
Wicked? Do you mean it's bad? Why is it bad?
Starting now, no one will ever die again!
Isn't this the most amazing science ever?
I'll tell everyone...
Never dying is the same as dying.
It can be even more terrifying.
A never ending world.
Millions, trillions of old people
would crowd our little planet.
Food and resources would be limited.
It would inevitably become a realm
where a self-proclaimed God decides who to purge by eternal petrification.
A dystopia!
Whether we can fight cellular aging will forever remain a mystery.
The device is out of battery.
There's no way to conduct clinical trials now.
Until we figure out the details,
it's better if we keep this between the four of us.
If the future revived ones
hear about the possibility of a world without death,
the rules of the world could change drastically.
It could get out of control.
Dr. Stone, that controls eternal life.
If we get control of this science, we could become absolute dictators.
But you still took the risk and showed it to me.
What was the reason?
That...
Isn't that the intercom
that picks up sounds over radio waves, from Treasure Island?
Whyman's example of "12,800,000 meters, one second."
The frequency is set so you can hear the lunar broadcast.
It's in complete silence.
The petrification voice that Whyman kept blasting...
As soon as the humans stopped moving, he hasn't said a word.
Isn't it obvious?
Xeno, I don't know the reasons, but Whyman...
is trying to turn everyone to stone as long as humans exist in this world.
The rules for humans have completely changed in this New World.
There are no more dictatorships or anything like that.
And everyone is immortal.
In exchange, we're forever trapped in Whyman's stone prison.
If someone isn't happy with that...
So we have no choice
but to go to the Moon and settle this directly, right?
All of Stanley Snyder's attacks were either:
A: Legitimate acts of combat on the battlefield.
B: Murder attempts.
It's us who get to testify here. Am I right?
If we bring back Stanley after restoring civilization...
We will all testify it was option A.
This is a card we can give to Xeno.
And in exchange for your card,
you get Dr. Xeno from NASA's full cooperation in building a rocket.
What an elegant deal.
Wouldn't it be risky to bring Xeno's friends here?
I don't think Xeno would betray us, given the circumstances.
Still, this ceremony is really important.
Xeno will cooperate with the plan for the sake of his pride, too.
Hey, Gen... did you happen to hear that yesterday too?
Huh? What do you mean?
I'll do it.
Let's begin, then.
DR. XENO JOINED YOUR GROUP!
It took ten...
no, 3,700 years,
but we finally joined forces...
To build a spaceship in a stone world.
Having traveled thousands of kilometers away from Japan...
Now, at last,
we're at the starting line on our way to space!
Through oceans and mountains, and now across the vast skies too!
If we keep going steadily, step by step, we'll definitely get there!
All right, time to start crafting!
START RARE METAL
This is our roadmap to the spaceship!
SPACESHIP GOAL
Our final step for the revival of humanity.
We'll take back the future of 7.8 billion people
from Whyman's hands!
This is tempting!
NEXT EPISODE
